units metal

pair_style eam/alloy

neighbor 2.0 bin

run 10000

fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT Heating
fix 1 all npt temp 300 2000 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 20000
unfix 1

variable volume equal vol
variable density equal v_mass/v_volume
print "Final density: ${density} g/cm^3""}
